_name: Unique identifier for this run (used in log messages and output paths).
name: my-single-run
_doc: Pipeline: run_single.sh  —  one model generates, scores, and trains on its own responses.

models._policy: Path to the initial policy model (will be updated at each training step).
models._reward: Path to an external reward model for scoring. null = use the policy model itself (self-certainty / MV).

dataset._key: Dataset identifier. Options: 'math_lighteval', 'gsm8k', etc. See utils/dataset.py.
dataset._max_samples: Cap on total problems loaded from the dataset. null = use all.
dataset._system_prompt: System message prepended to every prompt (via chat template).
dataset.system_prompt: You are a helpful AI Assistant, designed to provided well-reasoned and detailed responses. You FIRST think about the reasoning process step by step and then provide the user with the answer. Please enclose your final answer in the box: \boxed{Your Answer}. Please stop generation immediately after outputing the box.
dataset._prompt_mode: Predefined prompt preset: 'system' (system prompt, no suffix), 'suffix' (no system, instruction suffix), 'bare' (nothing, TTRL style). null = use individual fields.
dataset._instruction_suffix: Instruction suffix appended to user message. null = use per-dataset default. Empty string = no suffix.
dataset._enable_thinking: Control enable_thinking for chat template. 'false' (default), 'true', 'none' (don't pass — TTRL style).
dataset._problems_per_step: Number of problems sampled per training step. Effective batch = num_gpus × per_device_batch_size × gradient_accumulation_steps.
dataset._shuffle: Whether to shuffle the dataset before each step.

generation._num_generations: Number of completions to generate per problem. Effective training samples = problems_per_step × num_generations.
generation._temperature: Sampling temperature for vLLM generation. Higher = more diverse.
generation._repetition_penalty: Repetition penalty for generation. 1.0 = no penalty.
generation._max_completion_length: Maximum number of tokens per generated completion (vLLM max_tokens). Also caps completion length during training.
generation._max_prompt_length: Maximum prompt length in tokens (truncates from left). Keep short to leave room for completions.

scoring._scoring_batch_size: Number of prompts per scoring batch (in-process). Reduce if GPU OOM during scoring.
scoring._logps_batch_size: Number of prompts per logp computation batch. Reduce if GPU OOM during logp step.
scoring._mask_truncated_completions: Deprecated. Has no effect; kept for compatibility.

reward._mode: Reward signal source. 'intuitor' (self-certainty / SCE), 'trajectory' (logprob), 'truth' (ground-truth 0/1), 'wmv' (weighted majority vote), 'mv' (unweighted majority vote). For 'intuitor' and 'trajectory', the denominator is controlled by length_norm.
reward._length_norm: Length normalization denominator for 'intuitor' and 'trajectory' modes. 'response' = divide by individual response length (default); 'rollout' = divide by sum of all response lengths in the rollout group.
reward._scorer: HACRL scorer backend for reward_mode='truth'. Options: default | hacrl_math_dapo | hacrl_math_boxed | hacrl_prime_math | hacrl_gsm8k | hacrl_qa_em. Ignored when mode != 'truth'.
reward._beta: KL penalty coefficient (GRPO β). 0.0 = no KL penalty. Typical range: 0.0001–0.001.

training._num_gpus: Number of GPUs for training (passed to accelerate --num_processes).
training._max_steps: Total number of outer training steps (iterations over the dataset).
training._start_step: Step to resume from. 0 = start fresh. The script skips generation+training for steps < start_step if a checkpoint exists.
training._per_device_batch_size: Per-GPU micro-batch size during training. Effective batch = num_gpus × per_device_batch_size × gradient_accumulation_steps.
training._gradient_accumulation_steps: Gradient accumulation steps. Set so that effective_batch = problems_per_step × num_generations. Example: 128p × 7gen / (2gpu × 2bs) = 224.
training._learning_rate: Peak learning rate for the optimizer (AdamW). Use string to avoid float precision issues.
training._warmup_ratio: Fraction of total steps used for linear LR warmup.
training._torch_dtype: Model dtype for training. 'bfloat16' recommended for Ampere+ GPUs.
training._bf16: Enable bfloat16 mixed precision training (requires Ampere+ GPU).
training._gradient_checkpointing: Recompute activations during backward pass to save GPU memory at the cost of ~30% slower training.
training._num_iterations: Number of GRPO update iterations per step (μ in GRPO). 1 = standard single-pass.
training._epsilon: GRPO clipping ratio ε (like PPO). Typical: 0.1–0.2.
training._objective_mode: Policy objective. 'grpo' keeps existing token-level training; 'gspo' uses sequence-level ratio.
training._is_length_norm: Length normalization for sequence-level ratio when objective_mode='gspo'. Options: 'mean', 'sqrt_len', 'none'.
training._self_update_epsilon_low: Lower epsilon for self-update GSPO clipping. Overrides global epsilon. null = use global epsilon.
training._self_update_epsilon_high: Upper epsilon for self-update GSPO clipping. Overrides global epsilon_high. null = use global epsilon_high.
training._accelerator_config: Accelerate config name (without .yaml). Maps to recipes/accelerate_configs/<name>.yaml. Options: 'zero3', 'zero3_cpu_offload'.

vllm._port: Port for the vLLM OpenAI-compatible server. Pick a free port; avoid conflicts with other runs.
vllm._gpu: CUDA device index for the vLLM server (0-indexed). Should be a GPU NOT used for training.
vllm._gpu_memory_utilization: Fraction of GPU memory reserved by vLLM KV cache. 0.9 is a safe default; lower if OOM.
vllm._max_model_len: Maximum sequence length (prompt + completion) for vLLM. Must be ≤ model's max_position_embeddings.
vllm._max_num_seqs: Maximum number of sequences in flight at once in vLLM. Higher = better throughput but more memory.
vllm._max_num_batched_tokens: Maximum total tokens in a single vLLM batch. Tune with max_num_seqs for throughput vs memory.
vllm._chunked_prefill: Enable chunked prefill in vLLM for better GPU utilization with mixed short/long sequences.
vllm._start_timeout: Seconds to wait for the vLLM server to become healthy before aborting.

output._checkpoint_dir: Root directory for saving training checkpoints. The latest checkpoint is always kept under <dir>/model/.
output._lighteval_prefix: Output path prefix for LightEval results.
output._ttrl_dir: Root directory for TTRL evaluation results.

eval._doc: Each evaluation backend is independently toggleable. Set 'enabled' to true and fill in 'tasks' to activate.
eval._max_new_tokens: Max tokens generated during evaluation (shared across backends).
eval._local_datasets_root: Local HuggingFace dataset cache directory (shared across backends).

lighteval._doc: LightEval backend (vLLM). Set enabled=true and list tasks to activate.
lighteval._prompt_mode: Prompt preset for lighteval wrapper: 'system' (use system_prompt) | 'bare' (no system).
lighteval._system_prompt: Optional lighteval-only system prompt. null = fall back to dataset.system_prompt.

zeroeval._doc: ZeroEval backend (CRUXEval etc.). Set enabled=true and list tasks to activate.

hacrl._doc: HACRL scorer backend (sympy / Minerva / boxed / QA). Set enabled=true, pick a scorer, and list tasks.
hacrl._scorers: default | hacrl_math_dapo | hacrl_math_boxed | hacrl_prime_math | hacrl_gsm8k | hacrl_qa_em

ttrl._doc: TTRL evaluation backend (TTRL-style scoring on TTT datasets). Set enabled=true and list tasks to activate.
